title: Jamaican Blueberry Bake
description: A sweet and spicy dessert that combines the flavors of Jamaica with the simplicity of a blueberry bake.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together butter, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Gently fold in the blueberries and jerk seasoning.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
